record.field: Allow URL for Muppy builtin DNS (MBD) operations.

# Defined in muppy ^/mpy/dns/v1/lego/(present|cleanup)$ # httpreq JSON routes (Traefik / lego) ^/mpy/dns/v1/lego-http/(present|cleanup)$ # httpreq HTTP routes (cert-manager webhook, K8s) ^/mpy/dns/v1/records(\?|$) # MBD records API, with or without query string ^/mpy/dns/v1/custom-hostnames(\?|$) # MBD custom hostnames API ^/inouk/api_auth/v2/token/status/(bearer|awssigv4|httpbasic)$ # Token status, one route per token type
